drafts.title: Say Hi
drafts.pitch: The Judge's eval is one word, "hi," and Cursor can't score above a 3 while Tilde gets a 10 for the same word.
drafts.reason: 'I said it tired' is a strong closer and the Judge fits the world, but the repeated '3' beats run long and the premise is slightly harder to read at a glance.

drafts.title: Newest Model
drafts.pitch: Cursor brags that it's the newest model in the room, right up until a newer one walks in.
drafts.reason: It reads instantly and 'About a week' is a nice Tilde line, but the newer-model-replaces-you setup is predictable and visually busy.
